title_en: News Roundup: Pakistani Astronaut, Short-Drama Regulation and Anti-Corruption Cases
summary_zh: 2026年11月5日至7日，长沙晚报网天下事栏目汇总多条要闻，涉及神舟二十四号任务、微短剧专项治理、秋粮收购、余艳红被审查调查及马兴瑞被公诉等。
summary_en: A Nov 5-7, 2026 roundup from Changsha Evening News covered items including a Pakistani payload expert on the Shenzhou-24 mission, regulation of short dramas, autumn grain purchases, and corruption cases involving Yu Yanhong and Ma Xingrui.
